title: Wren and the Autopsy
author: Lior Galloway
blurb: Oscar Marchetti, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
